title: "Differential Accessibility Analysis - `r task_name`"
author: `r email`

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(edgeR)
library(data.table)
library(EnhancedVolcano)

groups_tbl=fread("fileList4.txt", header=FALSE, data.table=FALSE) |>
  dplyr::rename(Sample=1, Group=2)

pairs_tbl=fread("fileList5.txt", header=FALSE, data.table=FALSE) |>
  dplyr::rename(Group=1, Comparison=2)

group_identifier = c("Ang", "Veh")

anno_peaks_file = fread('fileList2.txt', header=FALSE, data.table=FALSE)$V1[1]
anno_peaks = fread(anno_peaks_file, header=TRUE, data.table=FALSE) |>
  dplyr::rename(Peak_ID=1)

gencode_anno_file = fread('fileList3.txt', header=FALSE, data.table=FALSE)$V1[1]
gencode_anno = fread(gencode_anno_file, data.table = F, header = T)|>
  dplyr::rename(Peak_ID=1)
```

# Peak calling summary

```{r}
indiv_peaks = read_file_map('fileList6.txt')
summ_tab = as.data.frame(matrix(nrow = length(indiv_peaks), ncol = 22))
names(summ_tab) = c(paste0("chr", 1:19), "chrX", "chrY", "Total")
row.names(summ_tab) = names(indiv_peaks)
for(i in 1:length(indiv_peaks)){
  tmp = fread(indiv_peaks[[i]])
  for(c in c(1:19,"X", "Y")){
    summ_tab[i,paste0("chr",c)] = nrow(tmp[which(tmp$V1==paste0("chr",c)),])
  }
  summ_tab[i,"Total"] = sum(summ_tab[i,1:21])
}
summ_tab=summ_tab |> tibble::rownames_to_column("Sample")
summary_tsv=paste0(task_name,  ".peak_summary.tsv")
write.table(summ_tab, summary_tsv, row.names = FALSE, quote = F, sep = "\t")
print_table(summ_tab, byDT=TRUE, row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r}
fc<-reshape2::melt(summ_tab[,1:22], id.vars="Sample") |>
  dplyr::rename(Chrom=variable, PeakCount=value)
fc$Chrom=factor(fc$Chrom, levels=unique(fc$Chrom))

height=max(2.5, length(unique(fc$Sample)) * 0.2 + 0.5)
summary_chromosome_png=paste0(task_name,  ".peak_summary.chromosome.png")
g<-ggplot(fc, aes(x=Chrom, y=Sample)) + 
  geom_point(aes(size=PeakCount)) + theme_classic() + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust=1,vjust=0),
        axis.title = element_blank())
ggsave(summary_chromosome_png, g, width=7, height=height, dpi=300, bg="white")
include_graphics(summary_chromosome_png)
```

```{r}
width=max(3, length(unique(fc$Sample)) * 0.2 + 2)
g=ggplot(summ_tab, aes(x=Sample, y=Total)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity") + theme_classic() + 
  ylab("Total peak count") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust=1,vjust=0.5),
        axis.title.x = element_blank())
summary_png=paste0(task_name,  ".peak_summary.png")
ggsave(summary_png, g, width=width, height=2.5, dpi=300, bg="white")
include_graphics(summary_png)
```

}
comp_rmd="comp.rmd"
writeLines(comp_content, comp_rmd)
